newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 20.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Defence Ministry says 250 tamil rebels (LTTE) and 54 soldiers have died in the first six days of Operation Jaya Sikuru, or "Sure of Victory".
Sri Lanka Air Force helicopter gunships blow up LTTE ammunition depot north of Omanthai, defence sources said.

A British funded project to provide electricity to Jaffna residents has been partly completed, government officials said. Four mobile generators funded by the British government are due to become operational on Tuesday.
Air Forces says its gunships destroyed LTTE ammunition depot and 15 senior rebels, in recent air strikes.
LTTE women's corps leader in the norther Wanni region and two other senior cadres killed in recent fighting at Omanthai, security sources say.
